trigger_condition: Uncommitted change: in plant mode with one block, the card shows «Оформить заказ» and the footer shows «Оформить всё», and both buttons do the same thing. With several blocks the card label «Оформить подзаказ» clashes with the mode description «На каждую площадку оформляется отдельный заказ» and with the result dialog «Создан черновик». The RPC creates independent customer orders, not sub-orders of a parent.
guard_snippet: Hide the footer button (or the block button) when visibleBlocks.length === 1. Label the per-block action «Оформить заказ по {block.sourceCode}» instead of «подзаказ», so it matches the order model and the result dialog.
potential_consequence: Users see duplicate CTAs. They also expect a parent order containing sub-orders, which the system never creates, so they get confused about the order structure.

trigger_condition: The new doc sentence says that in «Склад региона» mode there is one block because «всё везётся с одной площадки». That is wrong: hub mode is one block because there is one regional hub warehouse. The goods still come from many plants, and «площадка» means a plant elsewhere in this doc.
guard_snippet: Reword: «В режиме «Склад региона» блок всегда один — все товары собираются на хабе региона, поэтому кнопки у блока нет — только «Оформить всё».»
potential_consequence: The feature doc teaches the wrong domain model (hub equals one plant). Future changes built on it, such as plant splitting or container calculation in hub mode, will be designed incorrectly.

trigger_condition: store_checkout_customer_order calls store_apply_currency_rates(p_rates). Every cart checkout therefore overwrites the global store_currency.rate catalog with the browser's live 'float' rates. When float rates failed, the client sends null, yet the UI totals were computed with fallbackRates.
guard_snippet: Write the rates into the order's own store_order_money.rates snapshot only, not the global store_currency catalog. Pass the same `rates` object to the RPC that the UI used for totals (floatRates ?? fallbackRates).
potential_consequence: A customer checkout silently changes exchange rates for every other order, pricelist and money view in the demo. The order snapshot can also differ from the ≈ total the user saw before confirming.

trigger_condition: lineTotal = unitPrice * quantity and supplyCostAmount * quantity are never rounded. Currency totals are then summed as raw floats, while the server stores round(quantity, 2) × unit_price.
guard_snippet: Wrap with roundMoney: `lineTotal: roundMoney(priced.unitPrice * item.quantity)`, apply the same to supply totals, and accumulate in integer cents.
potential_consequence: Displayed block and grand totals can be off by a cent from the order money computed server-side, which undermines 'the price shown is the price ordered'.

trigger_condition: The cart catalog snapshot (`requested`) is never invalidated for the whole session. The RPC trusts the client's unit_price unconditionally and overrides store_resolve_line_price.
guard_snippet: Refetch the cart catalog when the checkout page mounts (or on visibilitychange), or reprice on the server: compare the client price to dealer price × (1 + supply%) and reject or replace it on mismatch.
potential_consequence: After someone edits prices or statuses, orders are created at stale prices, even for variants that are now unavailable. Order money then disagrees with the catalog.

trigger_condition: The «В корзину» button checks only dealerStatus and price, not selectedVariant.deletedAt, even though archived variants are selectable when «Архив» is on. cart-catalog filters out deleted rows, so the checkout line shows the raw numeric variantId as its name.
guard_snippet: Add `if (selectedVariant.deletedAt) return "Вариант в архиве"` to the block reason. In checkout, show a ghost line as «Товар удалён» with a remove action, and prune lines whose ids were requested but not returned.
potential_consequence: Users can put archived products in the cart. Checkout then shows lines named like '1234' that can never be ordered and never leave the cart on their own.

trigger_condition: parsePlantIdFromSiteCode hardcodes `PLT-` and search hardcodes `PRD-`. Site filter options, however, come from formatEntityCode, which uses the configurable code-prefix registry (Settings → Префиксы кодов).
guard_snippet: Build the regexes from getActiveEntityCodePrefixes().plant and .product (escaped), or pass the plant id itself as the filter option value instead of reparsing the label.
potential_consequence: After the plant prefix is changed in Settings, every production-site filter matches `id = -1` and the catalog goes empty. Code search by the new product prefix also stops working.

trigger_condition: hubCode is computed once in loadStoreRegions through formatEntityCode, which reads module-global activePrefixes. RegionProvider never awaits loadEntityCodePrefixes, so the result depends on load order.
guard_snippet: Store only hubWarehouseId in context and format the code at render time after the prefixes have loaded, or await loadEntityCodePrefixes() inside loadStoreRegions.
potential_consequence: The hub shows as the default 'WH-n' while other screens show the custom prefix. This breaks the place-codes convention of consistent codes.

trigger_condition: DB catalog items get brand 'Oryx', stock 0 and updatedAt '2026-09-01' hardcoded. The «Бренд» badge and the «Обновлено» column render these constants, while the product card reads the real store_brand.name.
guard_snippet: Select `brand:store_brand(name)` and updated_at in buildVariantQuery and map them. Drop the columns if no data exists.
potential_consequence: The catalog shows the same fake brand and date on every row, which contradicts the product card. The demo looks broken and misleads anyone evaluating the data model.

trigger_condition: Both `!page` (Supabase unset) and `.catch` (network or RPC error) set dbItems to [] with no message. Only load-more shows an error.
guard_snippet: Add `const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false)` and render an error card with «Не удалось загрузить каталог» and a «Повторить» button. Show a separate «Supabase не настроен» state.
potential_consequence: A backend failure looks like 'no products'. This is the pitfall AGENTS.md warns about: the UI can't tell a misconfigured backend from an empty one.

trigger_condition: resolveProductIdsForCategories is not paged, so it hits the 1000-row PostgREST cap. In pricelist (no-limit) mode, loadRegionPricing puts every variant id into one `.in(...)` GET, and category product ids also go into `.in("product_id", …)`.
guard_snippet: Use fetchAllRows with an order for store_product_category. Chunk `.in` lists to about 200 ids per request, or move the filters into an RPC or view that joins on the server.
potential_consequence: Category filters silently drop products past 1000 links. Once the catalog grows, pricelist bootstrap fails with 414/400 errors (URL too long) and falls back to fabricated seed data.

trigger_condition: store_product_supply_cost is paged with fetchAllRows but ordered only by product_variant_id, which has many rows per value (one per region). fetchAllRows' own contract requires a stable unique order.
guard_snippet: .order("product_variant_id").order("region_id") (or .order("id"))
potential_consequence: Past 1000 rows, pages overlap or skip rows nondeterministically, so supply-cost % is missing for some regions and hub prices drop the markup at random.

trigger_condition: When DB rows are missing, the pricelist invents prices and dealer statuses from hash seeds (getSeedCellValue / getSeedDealerStatus). The catalog and checkout treat the same variants as «нет дилерской цены» or unavailable.
guard_snippet: With a DB bootstrap present, return null or empty for missing cells and keep seeds only for the Supabase-unset offline mode. Visually mark any seed value («демо»).
potential_consequence: A manager sees a variant as 'Доступен' at a price in the pricelist, but customers can't buy it in the catalog. The two screens contradict each other with no way to tell which is true.

trigger_condition: Pricelist edits go only into an in-memory Yjs doc. The server destroys the doc when the last connection closes, nothing writes to store_product_price or status, and the default WS URL is ws://127.0.0.1:1234 even in the deployed demo.
guard_snippet: Persist cell edits to Supabase (debounced upsert into store_product_price / store_product_region_status), or at least persist the Yjs doc (y-leveldb / snapshot). Show «Изменения не сохраняются» when the collab server is unreachable.
potential_consequence: Every price edit disappears when the tabs close and never reaches the catalog or checkout. On the deployed site, collab silently tries to reach the visitor's own localhost.

trigger_condition: Presence identities are English ("Swift Otter", "Calm Falcon") and render as user-facing names and initials in the toolbar and on cells.
guard_snippet: Use Russian word lists, e.g. ADJECTIVES = ["Быстрый", "Тихий", …], ANIMALS = ["Выдра", "Сокол", …], with matching grammatical gender.
potential_consequence: Violates docs/conventions/ui/russian-labels.md: English text on a Russian UI page.

trigger_condition: Checkout UI renders English «Supply costs» in «в т.ч. Supply costs N%» and «Supply costs: итого».
guard_snippet: Replace with «в т.ч. расходы на доставку N%» / «Расходы на доставку: итого», and use the same term in the doc.
potential_consequence: Russian-labels convention violation on the main customer-facing page.

trigger_condition: /store/catalog duplicates /store/pim/products. /store/pricelists is a placeholder that shadows the real /store/pim/pricelists. Two different «Импорт/Экспорт» placeholders exist (StorePlaceholderPage vs ModulePlaceholderPage). /store/catalog is also whitelisted for customers in CUSTOMER_STORE_PATHS.
guard_snippet: Delete /store/catalog, /store/pricelists and /store/exchange, or make them `redirect()` to their /store/pim/* counterparts. Keep one placeholder component and drop /store/catalog from CUSTOMER_STORE_PATHS.
potential_consequence: Old links open an empty «Прайс-листы» stub instead of the real page. The duplicated URLs split bookmarks and navigation highlighting and leave two placeholder components to maintain.

trigger_condition: The customer role may open /store/pim/products/*, but the product card applies no role visibility. A customer sees «Добавить вариант», «Архив», the logistics tab with warehouse balances, the document ledger and the create-production-order dialog.
guard_snippet: Add a 'product' page to store_role_visibility (e.g. variants.add, tab.logistics, production.create), resolve it in viewRolePageForPath, and gate these elements via useViewRole like the customer-order card does.
potential_consequence: The demo's role switcher contradicts itself: the order card hides internal data from customers, but the product card lets them create variants and production orders.

trigger_condition: The dependency is circular: logistics imports store (region-context, RegionSwitcher, ContainerLoadCalculator), while store imports logistics in 11 files (nav, order-money, view roles, logistics-api, ledger UI).
guard_snippet: Move shared pieces (region context, container calculator, view-role, order-money) into a neutral module such as src/features/commerce-shared or src/domain, so the dependency runs in one direction (store → logistics or both → shared).
potential_consequence: Changes in either module ripple unpredictably, the two sections can't be split or lazy-loaded separately, and import cycles risk undefined-at-init bugs.

trigger_condition: The store module has two homes, src/features/store and src/components/store, which import each other (10 and 8 files). Core domain types (DealerStatus, StoreCatalogItem, CurrencyCode) live in *-demo-data.ts and pricelists-helpers.ts and are imported by the DB-backed cart and checkout code.
guard_snippet: Create src/features/store/types.ts (or domain/store) for DealerStatus, RetailStatus, CurrencyCode and StoreCatalogItem. Have both demo and DB code import from it, then move the PIM UI under src/features/store/pim.
potential_consequence: Deleting the demo data breaks production-path compile. Ownership is unclear, and new code keeps landing in whichever folder the author guesses.

trigger_condition: loadPricelistDbBootstrap first calls loadDbCatalogItems(), which already loads every variant's region prices and statuses, and then fetches all store_product_price and store_product_region_status again.
guard_snippet: Fetch the variant list without pricing (add a `withPricing: false` option), or reuse the RegionPricing result instead of the second fetchAllRows pair.
potential_consequence: The pricelist page startup does double the paged requests, including the `.in` with every id that fails at scale.

trigger_condition: useLogisticsStore({kind:"product"}) runs on every product card render, even though its data is used only on the «Логистика» tab. The tab is not the default.
guard_snippet: Move the logistics tab into a child component that calls useLogisticsStore only when variantTab === "logistics".
potential_consequence: Every product card view, including customers', pulls a full logistics snapshot. This slows the card and loads internal data that isn't shown.

trigger_condition: After the RPC succeeds, removeVariants drops the whole variant lines by id. If the quantity was changed during the in-flight request (here or in another tab synced through the storage event), the extra quantity is deleted too. A second tab can also submit the same cart again: there is no idempotency key.
guard_snippet: Subtract the submitted quantity instead of removing the line (`setQuantity(id, current - submitted)`), and pass a client-generated idempotency token that the RPC checks before creating.
potential_consequence: Users lose quantities they added mid-submit, or get duplicate draft orders when two tabs are open.

trigger_condition: Schema history has *_fixups migrations, store_checkout_customer_order is redefined in two migrations, and generated demo seed data (491 lines, 'do not edit by hand') sits in the migration stream next to DDL.
guard_snippet: Move demo data to supabase/seed.sql (or a seed script) and keep migrations DDL-only. Squash the fixup pairs while the schema is still exploratory.
potential_consequence: You can't reset schema without demo data. Regenerating seeds requires a new migration each time, and readers must replay chains to find the live RPC body.

trigger_condition: First catalog batch fails and a later batch for newly added ids succeeds

potential_consequence: Error banner disappears; failed items stay nameless and blocked forever with no retry

trigger_condition: Dealer price currency or amount changed in pricelists after checkout page load

trigger_condition: Region load throws, or Supabase unset returns null

potential_consequence: Stored selection silently becomes 'не выбран'; region is missing from the switcher

trigger_condition: Selected variant is archived (deletedAt set) but still has a price and status
